statement.description:
If you need Remote to terminate an employee in Colombia (whether inside or outside of probation) because of your company’s economic or organizational circumstances, a mutual termination agreement must be entered into with the employee. Otherwise, the termination will be deemed “without cause”, and could lead to extra costs for you.

During probation, you do still have some more flexibility on termination; for example, when the termination reason is the employee’s performance. For this reason, we still recommend setting the probation period to the maximum allowed.
